propositions: Five modules independently derive the sidecar directory path for a store, each with redundant symlink resolution logic scattered across hlc.py, compact_trigger.py, enrich_drain.py, doctor_locks.py, and queue.py

Unresolved-symlink bugs have been fixed separately in three tickets (nuclear-calm-heron, intangible-ladyish-vicuna, conscious-weighable-spittlebug), each addressing one site, indicating a systemic need for centralized resolution

A single frozen StorePaths class must encapsulate all canonical store path, git directory, git common directory, and sidecar derivations to prevent future duplication and unresolved-symlink regressions
A guard test must prevent new modules from computing sidecar paths outside the StorePaths owner by scanning for /.rebar joins and _rebar_dir definitions, with # store-path-ok: escape markers
